note: Both sets are factually accurate against Table 6-1: every value, unit and row condition I checked (e.g., TwFAStif 171.85E+9 at 70.08 m/0.8, TwGJStif 189.32E+9 at 52.56 m/0.6, TwEAStif 138.13E+9 at 0.00 m, TwSSIner 18751.3 at 17.52 m) matches the table, with no invented or misbound claims in either set. Set A is somewhat stronger on faithfulness: its quotes carry row context (elevation/HtFract plus the value) and it consistently gives both elevation and HtFract conditions, whereas Set B's quotes are bare numbers and three of its claims are trivial 'elevation = x' entries. Overall A is marginally better for verifiability and condition completeness.
